title: Spinner that pops into a success check
summary: A small loading spinner on a pale track ring snaps into a filled disc that pops to 2.7x with a check, holds, then clock-wipes back into a pie spinner. A 4 s loop for the done moment after any action.
use_when: The confirm beat right after a submit, upload or payment in a product demo
A looping micro-interaction tile for a feature grid or social post
Bridging a loading state to a result in a longer UI film
A silent, monochrome brand that wants one clear state change

look.type_style: no type; one geometric glyph: a thin light check (stroke ~2 % of frame) centred in a near-black disc

sfx.event: spinner snaps into the filled success disc (f30, f150)
disc reaches its pop peak and settles (f36, f156)

structure.shot: small loading spinner centred on flat pale grey: a thin dark arc running around a light grey track ring, ring 15 % of frame
structure.motion: arc head travels clockwise ~12 deg/fr (easings.linear, measured f24-f29 from a 30 fps strip) while the arc length shrinks from ~300 deg to ~40 deg; at f30 the arc closes to a full dark outline in 1 fr

structure.shot: success state: the ring becomes a near-black filled disc, 40 % of frame, with a light check in the centre
structure.motion: f31 stroke thickens inward, f32 fills to a disc; scale 1.0 -> 2.7x ring size on springs.pop: peak f36 (~18 % overshoot), settled ~f41; check fades in 4 fr f32-f35 riding the same progress; hold f41-f77

structure.shot: disc shrinks back to ring size and is clock-wiped into a solid pie wedge that spins on the track ring as the second loading state
structure.motion: f78-f80 check fades 3 fr; f79-f82 disc shrinks to ring size on easings.inExpo (5 fr); f82-f84 radial wipe removes ~3/4 of the disc; wedge rotates clockwise ~8-9 deg/fr while its angle breathes ~20 deg -> ~270 deg -> ~20 deg (sheet-01 cells 13-15, sheet-02 cells 0-3); at f150 the wedge closes to a full disc in 1 fr

structure.shot: success state again: filled near-black disc, 40 % of frame, light check centred
structure.motion: disc grows from ring size on springs.pop: f151-f155 rise (60 -> 176 px at 1/3 scale), peak f155-f156 (~18 % overshoot), settled ~f161; check fades in 4 fr f152-f155; hold to f197

structure.shot: the disc clock-wipes back into the spinning pie wedge; ends mid-spin with the wedge at ~270 deg
structure.motion: same exit as row 3 (check fade 3 fr, shrink easings.inExpo 5 fr, radial wipe 3 fr); wedge spin ~8-9 deg/fr (sheet-02 cells 11-15)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the field, fg for the disc and arc, muted for the track ring, bg for the check
params.content.cycles: loading -> success cycles (default 2, period 120 fr at 30 fps)
params.timing.loadFrames: frames of loading before the snap (default 30 first cycle, 72 later)
params.timing.holdFrames: frames the success disc holds after settling (default 36)
params.size.ring: track ring diameter as a share of the short side (default 0.146)
params.size.disc: settled disc diameter as a share of the short side (default 0.40)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips: period 120 fr (success snaps at f30 and f150, exits start f78 and f198). Disc 174 px ring -> 474 px settled (1188 frame), peak ~528 px = ~18 % overshoot on springs.pop, peak 5-6 fr after the snap. Exit accelerates (inExpo), entrance overshoots: never bounce the exit. The snap from spinner to disc is a 1 fr jump; the spring does the drama. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (source is silent). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): pie-spinner, clock-wipe, success-pop. Loopable from 2.60 s (rows 3-4 repeat with period 4.00 s); the full 8 s file starts with the arc variant, so loopable is false.
